standards_claimed: QSFP28 MSA SFF-8665 (QSFP+ 4X 10 Gb/s Pluggable Transceiver)
SFP28 MSA SFF-8402 (SFP+ 1X 28 Gb/s Pluggable Transceiver Solution)
general.notes: Adapter/converter (not a transceiver): RF channel of SFP28 receptacle connected to lane 1 of QSFP28; three remaining QSFP28 RF channels not connected. Vendor agnostic; direct path to SFP unit memory. Power stated as <0.1 W. Storage temperature -40 °C to +85 °C. Applications reference Nx100GbE switch/NIC QSFP28 to SFP28 cabling. Bit rates 10 Gb/s and 28 Gb/s appear in cited MSA compliance lines; ordering text states 25G channel from SFP28 to lane 1 on QSFP28.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether vendor should be inferred from smartoptics.com footer only. Consider schema values for adapter/cable products vs optical transceivers. Distinguish module payload rate (25G) from standard citation rates (10G, 28G).
